faq.sectionLabel: What's the risk? What are we not telling you?
faq.title: Honest answers to hard questions
faq.subtitle: We know you're evaluating this carefully. Here's what we'd want to know if we were you.

items.question: What happens to my data? Can you see it?
items.answer: Your data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). We never train our models on your data. We never access your data unless you explicitly invite our support team for debugging. Enterprise customers can run Vuen on-premise so data never leaves their infrastructure. We are SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant.

items.question: What if the AI gives me wrong answers?
items.answer: Every visualization shows the exact SQL query or data transformation used, so you can verify. Vuen flags low-confidence answers automatically and will say 'I'm not sure' rather than guess. We also show row counts and data sources on every chart so you can sanity-check instantly. That said — always verify critical business decisions, just like you would with any analytics tool.

items.question: Will this actually work with my messy data?
items.answer: Yes. Vuen handles inconsistent column names, missing values, and mixed formats. It will ask clarifying questions if something is ambiguous rather than silently guessing. We've tested with real-world data from hundreds of companies — the messy kind, not the demo kind.

items.question: What are the real limitations?
items.answer: Vuen works best with structured and semi-structured data (tables, CSVs, SQL databases). It's not designed for unstructured data like raw text documents or images. The free plan is limited to 40 interactions/month — enough to evaluate, but you'll likely need Pro for daily use. Complex multi-join queries across 10+ tables can take 3-5 seconds instead of sub-second.

items.question: What if I want to cancel?
items.answer: Cancel anytime from your account settings. No phone calls, no retention teams, no hoops. Your data is deleted within 30 days of cancellation, or immediately on request. We'll even help you export everything first.

items.question: Why should I trust a startup over Tableau or Power BI?
items.answer: You probably shouldn't replace them — yet. Start Vuen alongside your existing tools with a free trial. Most of our customers didn't switch overnight. They started using Vuen for quick answers in meetings, and gradually realized their team stopped opening the old dashboards. We're backed by Google for Startups and NVIDIA Inception, and we're SOC 2 certified.

faq.guaranteeDescription: 14-day free trial. No credit card required. Cancel anytime with one click. If you're on a paid plan and unhappy within the first 30 days, we'll refund you in full — no questions asked.
